notes: CDER CGMP letter for finished-pharmaceutical manufacturing: repeated Bacillus cereus recoveries from finished drug product and the manufacturing environment (including from a bulk component supplied by a sister Medline facility in Hartland, WI) with inadequate investigations/CAPA, poor aseptic behavior (gloves, cleaning) cited as a root cause, and a request that the firm assess transitioning these products to terminal sterilization or aseptic processing. Classified cgmp_nonsterile / is_sterile_product false because the letter's own recommendation to 'transition... to terminal sterilization, or implement aseptic processing' indicates the products are not currently manufactured as sterile, even though cleanroom/aseptic-behavior deficiencies are cited (aseptic_processing and environmental_monitoring included as judgment calls for that reason). All specific drug/product names are redacted as (b)(4). No recall, withdrawal, or distributed-batch assessment language is raised (only production suspension), so recall_concern is false.
